excel.title: Import properties from the approved template
excel.intro: Use the approved Kutayyib workbook: one sheet per property, preserving cell positions and labels.
excel.step1: Download the template and enter your property data instead of creating a new table.
excel.step2: Use one sheet per property. Duplicate sheets or delete unused ones; do not move cells or change labels.
excel.step3: Upload the .xlsx file, review the preview and import all properties after correcting errors.
excel.guide: How to fill in the template
excel.required: Required: description D5, type D7, area F7 (greater than zero), and deed number D8. Store deed, plot and plan identifiers as text to preserve leading zeros.
excel.formats: Closing date D3: day/month/year. Time E3: 17:30 or 5:30 PM. Enter the deposit F10 and lengths I14:I17 as numbers without units. Do not use formulas.
excel.links: Survey, additional images and location URLs go in I20, I21 and I22, or as hyperlinks on H20, H21 and H22. Use full http(s) URLs. Upload images in the images step after importing.
excel.missing: The template has no city field; complete it in the property form after import. Leave unknown values blank; **** and / are never converted into assumed data.
excel.wrongType: Select an .xlsx file using the approved template. PDF, images, CSV and .xls are not supported here.
excel.wrongSize: Select a nonempty file no larger than 10 MB.
excel.blocked: No properties have been saved. Correct every error and upload again; invalid sheets are never silently skipped.
excel.acknowledge: I reviewed the warnings and agree to import the displayed values. I will complete missing fields before generating the booklet.

issues.layout: Template layout mismatch. Expected “{expected}” here. Use the approved template without moving cells.
issues.missing_optional: This incomplete value will remain blank; complete it before approving property details.
issues.formula: Formulas and Excel errors are not supported. Replace with a direct value.
issues.number: Enter a valid nonnegative number; area must be greater than zero.
issues.date: Invalid date. Use day/month/year, for example 29/07/2026.
issues.link: Enter a valid, complete http(s) URL.
issues.invalid: Invalid value or field limit exceeded: {field}.
issues.duplicate: Duplicate property with the same deed, plan and plot. Remove the duplicate sheet.
issues.already_imported: This deed, plan and plot already exist in the project. Edit the existing property instead.
issues.identifier_precision: Excel may have rounded this long identifier. Enter it as text from the original source.
issues.conflicting_links: Two different links were supplied. Keep one link in the input cell or its label.
issues.city_missing: The template has no city field. Complete it in the property form after importing.
issues.dates_differ: Closing dates differ between properties. Check the day, month and year; values will be preserved as entered.
issues.unsupported_cell: Data was found outside supported template cells. Move it to the correct field or remove it to avoid losing it.

excel.cityHelp: The template has no city cell. Set a common city here, or complete it separately for each property after import.

supervisor.otherLogoHelp: Shown on the cover, in page footers and on its introduction page, where Infath's logo stands.
supervisor.otherLogoMissing: The body's logo has not been uploaded yet.

forms.title: Official auction forms
forms.help: The real estate auction request form (Real Estate General Authority) and the property study (Infath): each is a section of the project of its own and is issued alone. What the project's data and properties hold is taken from them directly; only the rest is entered here.
forms.missing: {count, plural, one {One field is still empty} other {# fields are still empty}}. You can generate now and complete them by hand, or fill them here.
forms.overflow: Some values are too long for their box even at the smallest size; shorten them.
forms.notInBooklet: Not entered in the project data
forms.refund: How bidders' money is returned (except the winner)
forms.receive_days: Days before the auction to receive money
forms.refund_days: Days after the auction to return money
forms.award_minutes: Time to award the highest bid
forms.rulings: Rulings on disposing of the property
forms.rights: Real rights or obligations tied to the property
forms.dispute: Mortgage, restriction or dispute affecting its use
forms.contribution: Real estate contribution tied to a property
forms.propertiesHelp: One property goes on page 3; several in the statement (page 4); agents in page 5.
forms.disclosure_hint: In the statement; empty: the status
forms.requestHelp: Filled directly from the project's data and properties (auction, properties, selling agent); only the remaining details are entered here. Issued on its own, without the booklet or any other output.
forms.studyHelp: One sheet per property, filled directly from the property's data in the project; the study's answers and notes are entered here. Issued on its own, without the booklet or any other output.
forms.issueHelp: Saves the form, then issues it from the project's current data as a draft for review and approval. The booklet, banners and posts are not needed.
forms.needsProperty: Add at least one property in “Project data” before issuing.
forms.issued: Form issued and ready for review

liveMarketing.help: The approved design from the auctions marketing and visual identity guide with your current values; it updates as you type.
liveMarketing.empty: Add a property to see the preview.
liveMarketing.retryHelp: The displayed preview is outdated. The latest change could not be rendered.
liveMarketing.overflow: These values are longer than their place in the approved design (shown at the smallest allowed size). Shorten them before generating:
liveMarketing.boardNote: Temporary preview at 1:10. Export places the guide's original design (vectors) beneath the values.
liveMarketing.postNote: Temporary preview at the post's real size. Export places the guide's original design beneath the values.

authorityReports.title: REGA reports
authorityReports.pick: After the auction: choose the auction's project to prepare the auction closing form and the outputs report. The auction, properties and selling agent come from the project.
authorityReports.help: The auction closing form and the outputs report on the Real Estate General Authority's templates.
authorityReports.projectHelp: The auction, its properties and the selling agent come from the project; the auction's results are entered here once and fill both reports.
authorityReports.auction_closingHelp: The authority's template: one statement row per property (deed, type and usage from the project); the award details are entered here. The statement repeats itself beyond 17 properties.
authorityReports.outputs_reportHelp: The outputs report's template pages: cover, introduction, marketing activities, boards, channels, participants, asset list and closing. A platform's page appears once its details or screenshots are entered.
authorityReports.resultsHelp: Entered once: they fill the closing form and the outputs report's asset list.
authorityReports.assetsHelp: Sale status and highest bid come from the results in the closing form; enter each property's opening price here.
authorityReports.introPlaceholder: Left empty, the template's text is used with the auction's, agent's and court's names.
authorityReports.overflow: Some values are longer than their place in the template, even at the smallest allowed size; shorten them.
authorityReports.draft: Temporary preview on the authority's own template; issuing places the original template (vectors) beneath the values.

fields.unsold_reason: Reason unsold assets were not sold
